text.description_html:
20 x 4 Wrap Around Plate for 1-3/4 Inch Door with 2-3/8 Inch Backset, Don-Jo CUSTOM

This Custom Wrap Around 9-inch Door Security Plate is for 1-3/4 inch thick doors with a 2-3/8 inch backset and a 2-1/8 inch bore-hole. Plates like this one are most often used to cover an existing bore-hole to change the backset, hole dimension, or knob placement. They can also be used to increase security at your home or office by protecting your doors from entry tools and tampering.

Features of the Don-Jo Custom Wrap Around 9-inch Door Security Plate:

  • Built-in stainless steel threaded insert for tube latch.
  • Flat Front Design
  • Long lasting and secure mounting of latch and bolt.
  • Heavy duty stainless steel trim screws
  • Permanent holding power eliminates loosening of latch mounting screws

Specifications of the Custom Wrap Around Plate:

  • Plate Length: 20"
  • Plate Width: 4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Center to Center: 5-1/2"
  • 2-5/8" from bottom of plate to center of bottom hole
  • Material: 22 (.032 gauge) construction
  • Finish: Dark Bronze

Custom item, NO RETURNS
